SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT PLANT, LEGACY_GR_NO , LEGACY_GR_SEQ FROM TBL_KEP_GR WHERE IF_FLAG = 'N' ORDER BY PLANT, LEGACY_GR_NO, TO_NUMBER(LEGACY_GR_SEQ)
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT 'HYOS' AS BUYER , 'KA' AS SITE , PLANT , LEGACY_PO_NO , TO_CHAR(LEGACY_PO_SEQ,'FM00000') AS LEGACY_PO_SEQ , STATUS , BUYER_ITEM_NO , CURRENCY_CODE , UNIT_PRICE , GR_QTY , GR_AMT , GR_DATE , MJAHR||LEGACY_GR_NO AS LEGACY_GR_NO , TO_CHAR(LEGACY_GR_SEQ,'FM00000') AS LEGACY_GR_SEQ , REMARK FROM TBL_KEP_GR WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
UPDATE TBL_KEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'Y' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
UPDATE TBL_KEP_GR SET IF_FLAG = 'E' , IF_DATE = SYSDATE WHERE PLANT = '$G_RS.PLANT$' AND LEGACY_GR_NO = '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_NO$' AND LEGACY_GR_SEQ= '$G_RS.LEGACY_GR_SEQ$'
